comparison_levels.name: FULL_ALGEBRAIC_SOURCE_REALIZATION
comparison_levels.carrier: smooth projective complex algebraic variety X as an algebraic locally ringed space, with algebraic morphisms; Coh(X) is added only when explicitly declared
comparison_levels.information_scope: algebraic structure actually declared; no analytic/Hodge data is silently added

comparison_levels.name: FULL_ANALYTIC_REALIZATION
comparison_levels.carrier: analytification X^an as a complex analytic locally ringed space; Coh(X^an), analytic morphisms, or coherent cohomology are included only when explicitly invoked
comparison_levels.information_scope: analytic topology + holomorphic structure sheaf, plus exactly declared analytic categories/data

comparison_levels.name: TOPOLOGICAL_REALIZATION
comparison_levels.carrier: declared underlying topological or homotopy realization of X^an
information_lost_from_full_an: coherent analytic sheaf category unless separately encoded
comparison_levels.warning: topological information is not identified with Hodge decomposition

comparison_levels.name: COHOMOLOGICAL_HODGE_READOUT
comparison_levels.carrier: declared rational cohomology H^*(X,Q) plus exactly the Hodge decomposition/filtration, cup product, pairing or polarization actually named
comparison_levels.information_scope: cohomological/Hodge package only; not the full analytic locally ringed space
comparison_levels.warning: the Hodge readout is not a synonym for full analytification

comparison_levels.name: STATE_COORDINATE_FINITE_READOUT
comparison_levels.carrier: a declared observation O such as finite coordinates, labels, scalar readouts, finite sampled states, or presentation-dependent outputs
comparison_levels.warning: non-factorization relative to a deliberately weak readout is not evidence of operational R2

declared_maps_and_non_maps.projective_gaga_scope: strong comparison on coherent sheaves, their morphisms and coherent cohomology; analytic coherent sheaves algebraize uniquely up to isomorphism

declared_maps_and_non_maps.lost_structure: full local analytic geometry is not retained by the declared cohomological package

partial_order_policy.rule: Comparison levels are typed by exact carrier and theorem language. A map may be declared only when constructed; absence of a proved inverse is not replaced by intuition.
notable_nonidentification: C_state(X;O) is weak unless completeness for the theorem-critical language is proved
